checker_commands: cd lean-mathlib && lake env lean Proofs/ChoiceFiberScopedTreewidth.lean
proof_idea: Split every monomial support into fixed and free coordinates, absorb fixed Boolean signs into its coefficient, and prove exact evaluation preservation.
Prove one Boolean elimination message correct from exact negative and positive fibers, then lift it inductively through an abstract exact message recurrence.
Transport exact restricted minima back to scoped minima of the source polynomial and compose them through an exact partition of the declared whole set.
Retain y + z + yz as a checked witness that independent minimization of overlapping owner bags reports an unattainable value.

aggregate_library_build.reason: The focused modules compile directly. A broad Proofs build is blocked on this host by pre-existing unrelated missing or invalid Mathlib/Proofs artifacts and prior exit-139 resource failures.

scope_limits: This proves an abstract composition theorem for exact Boolean messages, scope substitution, and exact coverage.
It does not prove the Python decomposition algorithm, its canonical encodings or roots, source binding, or Python/Rust refinement.

It does not prove tree-decomposition validity, running intersection, induced-width correctness, separator or factor ownership, local-factor plus child-message decomposition, runtime message-table verification, or resource preflight bounds.
It does not prove canonical argmin tie-breaking or the Python-bitmask-to-Lean-scope projection.
It does not prove RISC0 receipt soundness, a ZRPF guest, M6 closure, settlement authority, or production readiness.
